_comment: Permission rules for the unattended agent (claude -p in agent/pipeline.sh).
IMPORTANT: file permissions are matched on Edit(path) rules only. An
Edit(path) rule covers every file-editing tool, Write included. A Write(path)
rule matches nothing and is silently ignored, with a warning on every run.
So every path rule here is written as Edit(...). Do not add Write(...) back:
in deny it is a no-op that looks like protection, and in allow it is a no-op
